issue.title: Disambiguate duplicate agents sidecar entries in sase repo open
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-f2.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, 2026-08-03T19:37:39Z) during epic sase-f2's stored-file migration, and independently reproduced by epic land agent sase-f2.land on master 15e4213cc.

Every project's repo inventory carries two 'agents' sidecar rows with the SAME name and the SAME slug, differing only by path:

  {'name': 'agents', 'kind': 'sidecar', 'path': '/home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents', 'slug': 'sase--agents'}   # machine-level clone, cloned
  {'name': 'agents', 'kind': 'sidecar', 'path': '/home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase/sase/repos/agents', 'slug': 'sase--agents'} # not cloned

Reproduction from a numbered workspace:

  $ sase repo open agents -r '<reason>'
  Repo name 'agents' is ambiguous: sidecar 'agents' (/home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents), sidecar 'agents' (/home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase/sase/repos/agents)

'sase repo list' shows both rows (one cloned, one not). Because both candidates share a name and a slug, the error message offers no token that would actually select one, so the sanctioned path to an agents sidecar is a dead end. Agents that must reach the agents sidecar are pushed toward the very thing CLAUDE.md forbids: locating the checkout by hand. sase-f2.6 hit exactly this while migrating archived prompts and had to work around it.

Scope: make repo resolution collapse or rank duplicate sidecar entries that share a name/slug — prefer the materialized clone, drop uncloned phantom rows, or accept an explicit disambiguator (path or index) that the ambiguity error actually names. Fix the ambiguity error text so it always lists selectable tokens. Verify with 'sase repo open agents' and 'sase repo list' for a project that has both entries.
